chunks: He saw Him indeed another time
ai.seo_question: When did Prophet Muhammad see the Angel Gabriel twice according to Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to highlight the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him and his family) unique capacity for direct visual perception of the Divine or the Angel Jibril in his true form, distinguishing it from the limited sight of others. The 'second descent' is widely associated with the Night of Ascension (Al-Isra' wal-Mi'raj), where the Prophet witnessed the utmost signs of God, reinforcing the reality of the spiritual journey and the Prophet's elevated status. This event underscores the concept of 'Haqq al-Yaqin' (certainty of truth) attained through direct experiential knowledge rather than mere hearsay.
